contract: The logical biome is locked at the end of TerrainMap.intent from temperature, moisture and base elevation; later stages read the lock and never recompute climate tests.

Each axis has core classes and a transition position of the given half-width at every core boundary: 9 temperature x 5 moisture x 5 elevation = 225 inland biomes, 3 coastal kinds x 9 temperatures, and 8 water biomes (260).

Tuned for 8 km worlds (biomes-v4): elevation boundaries Y106 and Y129 sit below the coastal-plain height pile and at the land's 70th percentile; moisture boundaries 0.40 and 0.62 sit at the land's 23rd and 61st percentiles (climate-v3, six seeds), favouring the moderate and wet climates that grow forest (50-75% of land per seed) over the dry ones (16-31%); half-widths of 1 C, 0.025 and 3 blocks, with every core in use.

Final resolution may override only with water (ocean, river, lake, wetland, oasis), shore (beach, rocky shore, marsh) and height: the elevation position moves at most one step toward the final surface's position.
Hybrid identity: logical biomes map to vanilla IDs (inland through riven-habitats.json palettes at the core on the value's side of each boundary); a registered subset is future work.

River mouths: where a river's mouth weight is at least mouthFavour (Hydro mouthRadiusBlocks), the first matching mouth rule by temperature and moisture core (and rocky shore where required) takes precedence over shore and shallow-water overrides, but not deep ocean. Mangrove and salt marsh have no 1.12 biome; they map to swampland until a registered subset exists.
